messages:
maria_support: Heads up — Beacon Health (tenant beacon-001) hit a provisioning failure. Promo SUMMER2026 ended up on Hosted SKU instead of Private. Provisioning for on-prem failed with sku_mismatch. Ticket #78912. Pls advise.

raj_engplatform: Can you paste the provisioning error/logs? Is tenant id beacon-001?

maria_support: Here's the provisioning API error we saw:
```json
{
  "error": "PROMO_APPLIED_WRONG_SKU",
  "promo_code": "SUMMER2026",
  "applied_to": "hosted.standard",
  "expected": "private.enterprise",
  "tenant": "beacon-001",
  "request_id": "req_0a1b2c"
}
```

olivia_billing: I can see SUMMER2026 is attached to hosted.standard in the ledger. Looks like the PLG signup flow granted the hosted promo by default. We can reassign the grant to private.enterprise but need sales sign-off and a quick check on quotas.

sam_sales: @olivia_billing please proceed — Beacon is a POC for on-prem and needs Private. We need this changed today. Any impact on reported credits to the customer?

olivia_billing: Reassign will decrement the hosted grant and create a new private grant for the same promo code. It won't charge the customer twice but we do need to reconcile ledger entries. I'll run the transfer job and tag it with the ticket ID.

jess_ops: Heads up — don't let the provisioning retrier keep spinning while we move credits. If we flip promo mapping mid-provision we might get duplicate resource allocations. @raj_engplatform, can you pause the retrier for beacon-001 until confirmation?

deploy-bot: billing-cli job started: transfer-promo --promo SUMMER2026 --from hosted.standard --to private.enterprise --tenant beacon-001 (job_id=55233) :eyes: 

olivia_billing: Kicked off transfer from admin UI + queued ledger reconciliation. Waiting on background sync. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: job 55233 completed: transfer_successful; created grant_id=grant-98765 :white_check_mark:

raj_engplatform: Re-triggering provisioning now (retrier resumed). I'll watch for mount and network steps. Attaching quick provisioning reply when ready.

raj_engplatform: ```text
Provisioning OK
tenant: beacon-001
env: private.enterprise
instance_id: inst-42
status: READY
```

maria_support: Customer confirms they can access the private deployment and the onboarding checklist passes. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot: Raising a follow-up to figure out why the promo routed to Hosted during signup.

olivia_billing: Logged RCA as BILL-2341 to trace promo-routing rules. Early hypothesis: the signup form omitted the partner flag so the default SKU was hosted.standard. Will loop in product to add stronger validation.

sam_sales: Nice. Ping me when RCA is published so I can close the POC ticket with Beacon.

-- end of thread --
